selection: Earliest first crossing of 99% among runs with every subsequent validation at or above 99% through the final epoch. Reject runs with any later drop, even if they recover. Ties use measured training seconds, then smaller LR. No test data used.
timing_scope: Cumulative measured training loop time; includes lazy compilation, excludes validation, checkpoints, pauses, data setup, discarded partial epochs, and preceding LR candidates. Training plus validation sums the recorded timers.
resolution: First observed crossing after an epoch; no interpolation within epochs
compilation_caveat: Historical softmax includes eager and compiled runs; sparsemax is compiled. First-use compilation/cache warmup differs between LR candidates.
